about: Regions for tools/xdk_sigmatch/region_compare.py: the fog of the native renderer (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-09-native-renderer-fog-design.md, success criteria 4 to 6) at the daylight spots of the -BootSave Hero000 plans. The regions of the lighting validation (lighting-regions.json: 'far rock', 'far slope' and the near regions) are used beside these; this file adds far ground that lies clear of the ridge line and of the lake. Plan Task 4 defined the first of them; plan Task 6 extends the file.
coordinates: rect = [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the client area (0, 0 top left). Chosen on 1942 x 1136 window shots (client area 1920 x 1080 at 11, 45).

kinds.haze: far ground behind the game's haze, drawn and lit by the native pass: counts for criterion 5 (native mean luminance 0.75 to 1.25 of the emulated one, hue within 20 degrees). The emulated far hills carry the distant-tree billboards, which the native pass does not draw (spec ruling 6): a ratio compares bare hazed ground with wooded hazed ground
kinds.sky: above the ridge: the emulated sky against the native clear colour until the sky is drawn (plan Task 5); listed, not counted
kinds.not-drawn: the lake's surface, which the native pass draws flat and unlit (spec ruling 6) and therefore unfogged; listed, not counted

chosen_on: out/native-evidence/fog/task4_<spot>_on_shot_<t>s.png of 2026-10-09 (binary of commit 2487da6, fog on): bridge 42 s emulated, 45 s native, 48 s emulated; third 44, 47, 50. A run with another camera position needs the rectangles checked again (the third spot's walk ends slightly elsewhere from run to run). The trees spot has no far ground in view.
